scope.raw_arrays_read: Only scene time, initial_state, reference, wind and arm arrays; no log/state arrays.
scope.method: SHA-pinned manifests/files; HDF5 arrays restored to MATLAB orientation. cfg/opts numeric leaves compared at atol 1e-12; scene arrays exactly. No state mismatch used as a scene explanation.

C5_audit_note: C5 records are RUN_COMPLETE_RAW_PENDING_AUDIT; hashes verified here, but this is not a parent raw audit.

interpretation.TRAIN_membership: Both B scene IDs are TRAIN in pinned INPUT_MANIFEST and ALL816; audit rows PASS, with 1,999 events each.
interpretation.reference_initial: Both pairs have exact time, 12-zero initial_state, reference position/velocity/acceleration, yaw/yaw_rate/yaw_acceleration.
interpretation.external_inputs: Both pairs differ in wind, arms.command, arms.rho_true, arms.rhoDot_true; rho_hat/rhoDot_hat match exactly. The scene bundles therefore differ despite matched initial/reference arrays.
interpretation.plant_control_cfg: All 120 shared cfg leaves match; plant/control/RBF/reference/TCN/response-TCN/validation canonical hashes match. Selected actual values are recorded per pair.
interpretation.controller_opts: 11 of 13 common opts match. B position-RBF output/update=1/1; C5=0/0. C5 adds mask [1,1,0], delayed position prediction, enabled stage1 position runtime/search options. Attitude RBF and core attitude BS/filter config match.
interpretation.conclusion: Evidence rules out “same external scene/reference/controller configuration, only state distribution differs” as a complete description: wind/arm inputs and position-controller opts changed. Stored references and initial conditions match. This does not attribute the pre-deformation alphaBS shift to one cause. A changed position branch affecting requested motion/filter inputs remains a hypothesis. The original B producer source is unavailable per INPUT_MANIFEST.

limitations: No closed-loop states or alphaBS were used for causal attribution.
Equal command-filter parameters do not imply equal filtered command time series when upstream requested actions change.
